text: サファリゲームで　いける　ところまで　いってごらん　べんりな　ものが　もらえるよ！

structure.jp: いける　ところまで
structure.en: as far as you can go

structure.jp: べんりな　ものが　もらえるよ！

patterns.name: 〜てごらん
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus ごらん is a gentle 'try doing it', said to someone younger or lower. いってごらん = 'try going'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: いける is the 'can do' form of いく; もらえる later is the same kind of form. Here it describes the place after it. いける　ところまで = 'to the place you can reach'.
